recent_tweets.text:
exploring ways to spin up agents from my phone

iOS shortcuts × github actions × cursor cli

world_signals: quiet reckoning over what thinking tools should serve beyond the usual few
search habits casting about for compasses outside the default gate
a spare title hung like fog: leaving as its own small anthem
resolve folded into one metered ride away from a script written by others
bay spring in gray wool, twelve degrees, house pulse keeping the blood warm

composer-2-fast.concept: Ride a single cable line through thickened fog—swap lanes before mist swallows your glow, hoarding scraps of sunrise warmth against the chill.
composer-2-fast.session_hook: each run feels like scraping one clean breath of light from an overcast morning
composer-2-fast.escalation: visibility shrinks, cars/projections creep in, pickups drift off-beat
composer-2-fast.aesthetic: SF noir pastel, neon halo through pewter fog

gpt-5.5-extra-high.concept: Stutter-bloom catcher: blossoms only stay solid on off-grid micro-beats; you tap the hitch, not the downbeat, as false petals try to bait you.
gpt-5.5-extra-high.session_hook: landing the glitchy hitches stacks a satisfying asymmetric combo
gpt-5.5-extra-high.escalation: layered ghost blooms, BPM drift, swung triplets posing as doubles
gpt-5.5-extra-high.aesthetic: hyperpop holographic petals over ink-wash stems

claude-opus-4-7-thinking-max.concept: Trace one unbroken circuit linking task nodes before the context ribbon frays—you're drawing the shortest safe path through a shrinking graph.
claude-opus-4-7-thinking-max.mechanic: single-stroke path drawing on a tightening grid graph
claude-opus-4-7-thinking-max.session_hook: closing the loop sparks the whole DAG like a lite-up board clears
claude-opus-4-7-thinking-max.escalation: dead-end decoys, portals, timer eating unused edges
claude-opus-4-7-thinking-max.aesthetic: terminal-phosphor wireframe with soft Scandinavian pastels

gemini-3.1-pro.concept: Flick sea-glass shards into pastel tide pools by hue before an inbound swell reclaims the beach—physics toy meets micro-sort crusade.
gemini-3.1-pro.session_hook: glass clinks and water rings reward clean buckets in under a minute
gemini-3.1-pro.escalation: cross-shore wind bias, cracked decoys, dual-color pieces
gemini-3.1-pro.aesthetic: watercolor tide pools, frosted glass, muted spring bay palette
